question: Choose the correct meaning of the word 'Benevolent'.
explanation: 'Benevolent' means well-meaning and kindly. याद रखने की ट्रिक: 'Bene-' (Latin: good) जैसे Benefit, Benefactor में भी आता है।

question: Choose the correct meaning of the word 'Ephemeral'.
explanation: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time.

question: Choose the correct meaning of the word 'Candid'.
Identify the part with an error: (A) Neither of the students / (B) have completed / (C) their assignment / (D) No error
explanation: 'Neither' is singular, so it takes a singular verb: 'has completed', not 'have completed'। याद रखने की ट्रिक: Neither/Either + of + plural noun → हमेशा singular verb।

question: Identify the part with an error: (A) She is one of the / (B) best singer / (C) in the school / (D) No error
explanation: 'One of the' is always followed by a plural noun: 'best singers', not 'best singer'।

question: Identify the part with an error: (A) Each of the boys / (B) were given / (C) a separate task / (D) No error
explanation: 'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb: 'was given', not 'were given'।

question: Identify the part with an error: (A) The number of accidents / (B) have increased / (C) in the last few years / (D) No error
explanation: 'The number of' takes a singular verb: 'has increased'. (Contrast with 'A number of', which takes a plural verb.)

question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'Abundant'.
explanation: 'Abundant' and 'Plentiful' both mean existing in large quantities.

question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'Meticulous'.
explanation: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.

question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'Robust'.
explanation: 'Robust' means strong and vigorous, in good health or in good condition.
